app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $155 application fee, per Graduate Studies.
app_fee.quote: Applicants must pay a non-refundable application fee ($135 for domestic applicants or $155 for international applicants) to be eligible for admission.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate Studies fee waivers go only to domestic applicants from approved preparation programs; programs may offer a few fellowships.
fee_waiver.quote: Graduate Studies offers application fee waivers ONLY to domestic applicants who participated in one or more of the approved Graduate Preparatory Programs.

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule; the university sets no GRE minimum.
gre_general.quote: Some graduate programs require the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test and some also require the subject test.

toefl_min.value: A TOEFL iBT minimum of 4.5 out of 6.0 applies to tests taken from 21 January 2026; the admission criteria page still says 80.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum Score: A minimum TOEFL score of 80 is required for TOEFL exams taken prior to January 21, 2026 (old scoring), and a minimum score of 4.5 out of 6.0 is required for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026.

also.quote: The minimum TOEFL score required for admission to UC Davis is an overall minimum score of 80 on the Internet Based Test.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 on a 9-point scale.

also.quote: The minimum IELTS score is 7.0 on a 9-point scale.

english_waiver.value: A degree from an Indian institution waives the English test only if the IAU WHED database lists that institution as English-only; the page does not name India.
english_waiver.quote: UC Davis Graduate Studies will only approve waivers for foreign colleges and universities which list English as the sole language of instruction in the IAU World Higher Education Database (WHED).

also.quote: No other documentation (e.g. letters, language certificates, institutional websites) will be accepted for a waiver request.
